speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Master Thwaite has given us the unjust steward, and you have given us the side of your face.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard him begin, Mistress. I lost him after.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: We shall be brief in the porch, if nowhere else. The text was the steward who wasted his master's goods.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was counting, sir. Twenty pounds that is not mine, and not yet had.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Expected money. You have been spending it in your head since the bell rang the year in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shoes. My father's small debts. A horse at Lent. That is the list I made instead of the sermon.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then you preached a list to yourself, and missed the sentence that carries the text.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Give me the sentence, sir. I will not pretend I kept it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The unjust steward made friends of his master's goods, and the goods were not yet in his hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not yet in his hand. I can keep that piece.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Keep it better than you kept the hour. Sir John sat upright three rows ahead and went out as if the parish were his yard.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The Mayor's pew is the Mayor's pew. He sat upright. He did not come out to be greeted.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not look for a word from him. I have never had one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A servant of Crosby Place. He keeps the Mayor's door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have dropped your voice, Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have done no such thing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not catch a name.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then there was nothing to catch. I will not have it again on the stair.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: What you will not repeat, I will not ask for. The sermon is a plainer loss.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A plainer loss is a man who spends the hour on shoes. Did you hear any head of it after the counting?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard the unjust steward. I cannot give you the heads.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then do not invent them on the way home. One sentence will carry, if it is the sentence you were given.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Goods not yet in his hand. Is that the whole of what I was given?

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: It is the half a wandering ear may keep. The rest was for the people who stayed with the text.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf this morning was a penny, and a finger short of the notch. I am not measuring it again. The week has not mended.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard the finger on Friday, Mistress. I have not come to argue with the board.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Next Sunday, do your counting before you sit. I will not preach the steward a second time for one man in a side pew.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have the half of a sentence, sir, and none of the heads. That is the truth of the hour.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Dinner is threepence if you are at the board. I will not have a rehearsal of the sermon over a cold plate.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tonight I am only bad at church. I am not asking you for a plot into the bargain.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The goods are not yet in the hand. Begin there, when you try to remember me.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Come through the close. The wind is in this porch, and Sir John has taken his gate with him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming, Mistress. I will try the sentence once more when I am upstairs, and I expect to fail it.
